Resume

S SUDHAKAR M-Tech(InformationTechnology) Cell: +91-9632047083 E-mail:sarangam.sudhakar@gmail.com Passport No: C7171793

CAREER OBJECTIVE

To enhance my networking and management skills thereby utilizing my complete potential along with knowledge and training institute towards the best of organizational benefits.

BASIC ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

M-Tech (Information Technology) – The National Institute of Engineering (NIE), Mysore, Karnataka (Autonomous) Percentage: 8.17 CGPA Year: 2015-2017

B-Tech (Computer Science and engineering) - Gandhi Institute of Science and Technology, Odisha (BPUT University)

Percentage: 7.08 CGPA Year: 2010-2014

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Language: C Computer H/W: Hardware and Networking Tools: Microsoft Office CCNA Course Completed. CCNP knowledge

Working Experience

1) Currently working as Network Engineering Professional at BT eServe India Pvt Ltd (BT Group) from March- 2025 to till date. Roles and Responsibilities:

Performing upgrade and downgrade of router images (Juniper MX960/MX240, Cisco ASR1K, Cisco 3K switches) for IA, MPLS, and Cloud platforms. Supporting end-to-end commissioning and decommissioning of Points of Presence (PoPs) across EU, UK, AF, ME, APAC, and US regions. Provisioning and decommissioning MPLS uplinks, IA uplinks, core trunks, and gateway interfaces in a multi-vendor network. Executing JunOS and IOS-XE software upgrades with minimal service impact and well-defined rollback procedures. Successfully executed a major hardware upgrade by replacing MIC/SCBE/RE1800 with MIC-NG/SCBE2/RE-X6 and validating full post-installation functionality with zero alarms. Performing Layer-2 and trunk migrations, including bandwidth scaling based on capacity requirements. Implementing and modifying OSPF configurations to support new core links and decommissioning tasks. Executing ad-hoc configuration changes (ACL updates, QoS tuning, interface adjustments) across the core network. Collaborating with Network Planning, Cloud, IA, and Field teams for service expansion and infrastructure

General

optimization.

2) Rebatched as Senior Network Specialist to HCL Technologies Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru from March-2024 – March- 2025

Roles and Responsibilities:

Client: - Verizon Business.

I was Part of a dynamic network management team where my responsibilities are to manage the team as a Team Lead and work as Tech Lead to manage and troubleshoot the Network issue within given SLA.

I was working on a script based working model to tackle Quality issues on a repair ticket, where the SLA breaches and the client demand penalties. So, my working model had proved there is a minimal breach in just 3months of the model.

Built a working model for Network architecture where the ticket is auto built for the solution to the issue is highlighted and the tech’s work on the ticket resolve the issue within given SLA.

Quality Assurance and Quality Audits are part of daily BAU and reporting and documenting the data.

Part of Global IP Team where the enterprise and business customers enable their seamless communication between the servers, data centers and other network devices and establish network connectivity between the client and the partners.

Lead the transition team for the service desk LEC from onshore to offshore.

3) Worked as Network Operations and Service Analyst at Accenture Solutions Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru from May-2019- March-2024. Role and Responsibility:

Client: - Verizon Communications.

Network troubleshooting and Fault analysis and resolving the issue within given SLA and maximizing the network performance.

Trouble ticket generation with other 3rd party ISP and response carrier interface and escalations/prioritize the ticket coordinating with the 3rd party vendor ISPs.

Deployment of network services as per customer’s requirements.

Configurations change via our change control system and processes.

Work environment on Juniper and Cisco based routers. Working on Routing Protocol (BGP). Quality of service in MPLS, creating configuration scripts under vManage and executing in the customer routers.

Layer 2 and 3 network management on WAN based environment.

Network Support to Large Global Clients that have a distributed WAN and LAN Setup.

Senior SME SPOC for high revenue Clients, and responsible for being SME training new joiners.

I have been working as a Hybrid Engineer for 1 year now, as an Implementation Engineer (IE) for a leading US financial client, for migration of their services from vEdge devices to Cisco ISR1000 Series.

Efficient in handling a team of 25+ currently with 100% Efficiency and productivity.

With the recent internal promotion i have been given responsibility as Lead SME in handling the Team.

I have been trained and working for a project which has 3000+ sites to deploy the change design to their services.

Few of the Ideas that I have shared in automating the process, 2 of them have been automated and is very useful to the team in BAU work,1 of the automation idea is under pilot process.

I have also been recently crossed trained in Public IPs, and handling a team of 9 in the absence of the Lead, working on escalated emails and urgent deployments.

General

General

Getting trained alongside with the assistance of the Network architect on the change deployments and topology design of the customer network.

4) Worked as IT Support System Engineer at Aditya Birla Retail Limited (ABRL), Bengaluru from Oct- 2017- July-2018. Role and Responsibility: System and user administration in organization.

Complete IT Support (Technical and Infrastructure) at DC and Zonal Office.

Recommending and implementing new technical solutions.

Responsible for end-to-end support for local and remote users.

Software/Hardware instillation, upgradation and implementing file backups and configuring systems and applications.

Install appropriate upgrades, patches, drivers etc. Install and/or replace software components.

Setup new PC’s and printers. Identifying software applications, network and hardware malfunction and takes appropriate action to resolve issues and ensure data/system integrity.

Completing new rollout of objects in time as per business plan. Handling IT Assets management.

Responsible for IT Assets transfer from Source to Store location.

Handling Navision Support team calls and updates offers accordingly on daily basis.

Updates on Domain, which includes antivirus patch, windows updates and other system updates.

Monitoring and maintaining performance of network and keeping Virus free environment.

Networking Concepts: -

Installing, Configuring and Troubleshooting of Networking Equipment’s: Routers and Switches. Managing, Maintaining and Configuring Internetwork with the help of WAN technologies like PPP, Frame-relay, dedicated T1s, ISDN and Routing Protocols: OSPF, EIGRP, IGRP, RIP and RIPv2. Introductory knowledge of Layer-2 Switching, Vlan’s and Access-list. Good understanding of OSI Model, TCP/IP protocol suite (IP, ARP, ICMP, TCP, UDP, SMTP, FTP, TFTP) Well understanding of Bridging and switching concepts and LAN technologies IP addressing and sub netting, Routing concepts Implementation of HSRP, DHCP, DNS, FTP, TFTP, DMVPN. Actively involved in planned events and scheduled activities for network expansions & Testing to determine optimal solutions for network enhancement. Maintaining documentation for every change management request. Good understanding of BGP Protocol. Knowledge of SNMP Management and troubleshooting issues for SNMP Protocol. Worked on Activating and Troubleshooting 4G LTE Devices. Performing activities in IOS up graduation of Cisco Devices. Knowledge in SD-WAN.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Father’s Name Date of Birth Language Known Marital Status

: - S Venugopal : - 16thMay 1992 : - English, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada, Oriya, Tamil. : -Married

: - Indian : - Listening to music, playing sports : - (i) Work force Determination.

(ii) Strong will power of accomplishment. (iii)Ability to adjust and sustain the changing environment.

I do hereby declare that the above information provided is true to the best of my knowledge.

Date: 01-01-2026
